body:
Second pass over the transcript found and RESOLVED real design holes (not just flagged): two incompatible splitting systems never reconciled, no single-match win condition stated, energy-routing conflict resolution unspecified, the shared draft pool has no race-condition rule, a Naked Short exploit, and two Ultimates with no counterplay. New docs/SPEC_REVIEW.md plus docs/PHASE_D1..D6 with real scope-in/out and acceptance criteria per phase. DEADWEIGHT 9d28f3f, EMILY c89206a6. Still no game code -- D1 (local core loop) is next.

⚓ ☃
title: S371 D0b: spec review + per-phase development docs
